headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and risk assessment tools to improve the accuracy of ClearInstall's lockfile and install surface auditing. Leverage machine learning for better prediction of potential issues during npm/PyPI installations, including command expansion risks.
actions: Implement real-time dependency analysis using signals from Minireel/HGhub to detect emerging vulnerabilities and dependencies before installation.
